subject.title: DuckDuckGo (requiresCredential=false) is never auto-selected as web_search provider even when enabled

question: Should OpenClaw reverse the explicit opt-in policy and allow managed web_search to implicitly select key-free providers such as DuckDuckGo when no credentialed provider is configured?
rationale: Current main, docs, tests, and prior merged policy intentionally require explicit key-free provider selection, while the requested behavior changes outbound provider routing and user consent expectations.

options.title: Keep explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep DuckDuckGo selectable but not implicit, and rely on the current-main cron warning plus setup/docs guidance for users who need to configure it.

options.title: Approve implicit keyless fallback
options.body: Land a policy reversal only after updating runtime metadata, setup behavior, docs, compatibility tests, and real behavior proof.

options.title: Narrow to diagnostics only
options.body: Close or narrow the auto-selection request while tracking any remaining setup or doctor guidance for enabled-but-unselected keyless providers.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep DuckDuckGo selectable but not implicit, and rely on the current-main cron warning plus setup/docs guidance for users who need to configure it.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and merged the explicit key-free provider opt-in policy that this issue asks to reverse.
